developments.title: Evonik next-generation silane system for silica tire compounds
developments.what_changed: Launch of a new silane system claimed to lower rolling resistance versus Evonik's previous generation.
developments.technical_explanation: Improved silane coupling promotes silica dispersion and polymer-filler interaction in the tread compound.
developments.claimed_benefit: 12 percent lower rolling resistance in laboratory compound testing.
developments.baseline_conditions: Laboratory compound testing versus the company's previous silane generation; abrasion index unchanged.
developments.limitations: Supplier press release; no independent verification; tire-level results not shown.
developments.relevance_rationale: Directly relevant to tread compound development for rolling resistance.
developments.suggested_followup: Request technical data sheet and sample for internal mixing trial.
developments.confidence_reasons: Primary supplier source with quantitative lab claim but no independent corroboration.
evidence_refs: 12 percent lower rolling resistance in laboratory compound testing

rationales.impact: Potential RR improvement at constant abrasion.
rationales.actionability: Sample and trial can be requested.

developments.title: Bekaert details higher-tensile steel cord for EV tire belts
developments.what_changed: Higher-tensile cord grade presented for EV belt constructions.
developments.technical_explanation: Higher tensile strength allows thinner cords and lower belt mass.
developments.claimed_benefit: Belt mass reduction while maintaining stiffness.
developments.baseline_conditions: Comparison versus supertensile grade at equal safety factor.
developments.limitations: Trade coverage of a supplier presentation; no independent test data. [access: partial]
developments.relevance_rationale: EV belt mass and stiffness trade-offs are active topics.
developments.suggested_followup: Ask Bekaert for cord datasheet and gauge/fatigue data.
developments.confidence_reasons: Named supplier and plausible mechanics, limited data.

developments.title: HF Mixing Group tandem mixing energy savings technical paper
developments.what_changed: Technical paper quantifies energy savings of tandem mixing configuration.
developments.technical_explanation: Two-stage tandem mixing reduces peak power and improves temperature control.
developments.claimed_benefit: Up to 15 percent specific energy reduction in the mixing room.
developments.baseline_conditions: Case data from one reference line; compound dependent.
developments.limitations: Supplier case study; single-line data. [access: partial]
developments.relevance_rationale: Mixing energy and temperature control affect compound quality and cost.
developments.suggested_followup: Benchmark against internal mixing energy baselines.
